do: Play the main missions in order (Chapters 1–5). No mission gold medals exist, so play however you like.

Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (Positive Mental Attitude) — the one missable step. Talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning after Down to Earth, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. There are 15 manual slots and no mission replay — 10 saves cover the chapters, 5 rotate for free-roam cleanup.
Save in a fresh slot before the final mission.
Scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you go — both count toward the 100% checklist later.
Pick up optional missions as they appear (purple icons, black icons with pink letters). You need 100 for the checklist and there are far more than 100, so most arrive naturally.
Keep cheats OFF: cheats disable trophies and saving.
stages.goal: Finish all 5 chapters and the final mission. Every story trophy pops as you play; nothing in the story is missable except one meditation.
stages.name: Story — play it through

do: Open the checklist after the credits and work down it. Nothing on it is missable; everything can be done in free roam.
Robberies first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 34 of 35 Smash 'N' Grabs, 50 of 91 stick-ups, 8 bank vaults, 33 underwater discoveries — the full sets are required here.
Collectibles in part: 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 79 discovered styles, 200 of 277 base vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations.
Activities: gold all 42 shooting range challenges, 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges (skip the 10 hardest).
Do the partner trophies now that both characters are free: Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best, and the character questlines.

Launder $250,000 in marked bills (Dime on the Dollar), spend $100,000 in shops (Treat Yo Self), buy all 8 garages (Little Boxes) and register 10 vehicles (On the Spot) — all funded by the robbery grind.
stages.goal: Finish the 35-item 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, visible only after the story) and earn A Long Road. It is closer to 60% true completion — most items need only part of a set.
stages.name: 100% Completion — the long grind

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

do: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and others). Note: the named character questlines do not count toward this trophy.
Finish the character questlines if any are left: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton (treasure diving), Billy (Mudclub), Randy (16 cars), Tyrone (labs, Jason only), Bret (hunting, Jason only).

Do the one-off trophies: steal a docked airliner at VCIA, steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, and the unconfirmed ones (Ocean Beach cocktail, showroom smash, second-try, UFO sighting, melee drive-by) — check the linked guides for confirmed methods first.
When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! unlocks immediately.
stages.goal: Finish what the checklist did not cover, then the platinum pops.
